title: White Dew Solar Term
prompt: Describe the significance of the White Dew solar term in Chinese culture.
hint: Explain how the White Dew solar term relates to seasonal changes and traditional activities.
sample: The White Dew solar term marks the arrival of cooler temperatures and the crystallization of dew, signaling the start of autumn and important agricultural and cultural events.

title: Ghost Festival Rituals

title: Cormorant Fishing Tradition
prompt: Describe the traditional practice of cormorant fishing and its current status.
hint: Explain how fishermen train cormorants and how tourism has affected this tradition.
sample: Fishermen train cormorants to catch fish by tying a string around their necks to prevent swallowing. Although once a livelihood, tourism has changed how this tradition is practiced today.

title: Cultural Changes in Guilin

sample: Fishermen in Guilin have moved from living on boats to settling by the riverbanks and now participate in cultural performances, blending tradition with modern tourism.
